panels.title: Score probability density by State and Merchant
panels.description: 20 bins of width 0.05. Height = count / selected total / bin width; the area sums to 1. State and Merchant filters apply.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT score FROM transaction_scores WHERE $__timeFilter(processed_at) AND us_state IN (${state:sqlstring}) AND merch IN (${merch:sqlstring})
), counts AS (
  SELECT least(floor(score * 20)::int, 19) AS bin, count(*) AS n FROM selected GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT to_char((b.bin + 0.5) / 20.0, 'FM0.000') AS score_bin,
       coalesce(c.n, 0)::double precision / greatest((SELECT count(*) FROM selected), 1) / 0.05 AS density
FROM generate_series(0,19) AS b(bin) LEFT JOIN counts c ON b.bin = c.bin ORDER BY b.bin

panels.title: Processing TPS by State and Merchant
panels.description: Scoring timestamps, not CSV historical timestamps. Ten-second buckets; State and Merchant filters apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(processed_at, '10s', 0), count(*) / 10.0 AS tps
FROM transaction_scores WHERE $__timeFilter(processed_at) AND us_state IN (${state:sqlstring}) AND merch IN (${merch:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fraud share by category in the latest 1000 transactions
panels.description: Global last 1000 unique stored transactions by ingestion order; independent of time and segment filters. Fewer rows are used during warm-up.

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT cat_id, fraud_flag FROM transaction_scores ORDER BY ingestion_id DESC LIMIT 1000
)
SELECT cat_id, avg(fraud_flag)::double precision AS fraud_share FROM recent
GROUP BY cat_id ORDER BY fraud_share DESC, cat_id

panels.title: Top 10 merchants by flagged transaction amount
panels.description: Sum of amount for predicted fraud. State, Merchant and time filters apply. Potential exposure in source amount units; not a measured loss.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT merch, sum(amount * fraud_flag) AS flagged_amount
FROM transaction_scores WHERE $__timeFilter(processed_at) AND us_state IN (${state:sqlstring}) AND merch IN (${merch:sqlstring})
GROUP BY merch ORDER BY flagged_amount DESC NULLS LAST, merch LIMIT 10
